name: ARI MAKES A MISTAKE — Illustrated Story + Printable Calm Corner Toolkit for Ages 3–7
description:
ARI MAKES A MISTAKE

Five Gentle Steps to Try Again

Illustrated Storybook • Calm Corner Toolkit | Ages 3–7

Mistakes can feel very big — especially when something a child worked hard on does not go as planned.

When Ari’s sleeve tips over a water cup and blue water rushes across the carefully painted garden, anger and disappointment show up in Ari’s body. Instead of forcing Ari to fix the picture right away or pretending the mistake does not matter, Ari learns five gentle steps for noticing what is happening, naming the feeling, choosing something helpful, giving the body time to calm, and returning when ready.

NOTICE → NAME → CHOOSE → CALM → RETURN

Ari Makes a Mistake combines a warm illustrated story with practical Calm Corner tools that children can use beyond the book. It is designed to help young children build emotional awareness, recognize body clues, practice flexible thinking, explore calming choices, communicate their needs, and understand that a mistake does not have to be the end.

What’s Included

  • Illustrated digital storybook with 20 story pages
  • Calm Corner Toolkit with 8 printable tools
  • Feelings Chart — How Am I Feeling?
  • My Body Clues
  • My Calm Corner
  • Calm Choice Board
  • Star Breathing
  • Squeeze & Release
  • “I Need Space” Communication Card
  • Five-Step Calm Cycle

Created for Little Learners

Ideal for ages 3–7 and suitable for calm corners, home routines, preschool-age learning activities, creative-time conversations, quiet-time practice, and everyday moments when mistakes feel overwhelming.

The story does not teach children that anger, disappointment, or other big emotions are “bad.” Instead, it shows that feelings can be noticed, understood, supported, and given time — without punishment, shame, or pressure to calm down instantly.

A Story + Tools Children Can Actually Use

Children see Ari use the same strategies included in the printable toolkit, helping connect the story to real-life practice.

Read the story together, explore the tools, and let your child discover what helps Ari’s body feel safer and steadier after something goes wrong.

Mistakes can still feel hard. Self-compassion and confidence can still grow.

Digital product — no physical item will be shipped.
For personal use only. Not for resale or redistribution.
